board_rules: Parallelism only between tasks with disjoint files_expected and satisfied depends_on.
One commit per implementable task, message format: '<task-id>: <short description>'.
Definition of done per task: task-scoped tests pass, lint clean, diff limited to files_expected, evidence recorded in the task's 'validation' field.
License guard (RBAC_DESIGN §2): never copy from upstream commits at/after 358544dd7 (BSL).

work_waves.comment: Suggested scheduling; workers may pick any 'ready' task while respecting the max-5 cap.
